items.title: Why this CIO sees the S&P 500 climbing above $8,000 by year-end
items.summary: Market Domination Overtime Host Josh Lipton welcomes Blanke Schein Wealth Management chief investment officer Robert Schein to discuss why he believes the S&P 500 (^GSPC) can finish the year above 8,000 and the key catalysts that could drive the market higher.

items.title: The companies emerging as new leaders in this renewed AI rally
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Markets and Data Editor Jared Blikre examines the comeback seen across the semiconductor landscape over the past five trading days, while also analyzing which companies are emerging as leaders in the renewed AI rally.

items.title: AI CapEx fears: Is big tech overspending?
items.summary: Host Kenny Polcari joins Man Group Chief Market Strategist Kristina Hooper and Legato Financial CIO Ryan Kelly to debate the risks of massive AI CapEx spending and how a hawkish Federal Reserve could impact markets ahead of the midterms.

items.title: Should Henry Schein’s Raised 2026 Sales Growth Guidance Require Action From Henry Schein (HSIC) Investors?
items.summary: Henry Schein, Inc. reported past Q2 2026 results with sales rising to US$3,458 million and net income to US$94 million, alongside higher basic and diluted earnings per share from continuing operations versus a year earlier. Importantly for long-term watchers, management also raised its 2026 total sales growth guidance, signaling greater confidence in the company’s operating initiatives and demand trends. items.title: Review & Preview: The Dow’s Streak Survives
items.summary: The Dow Jones Industrial Average weathered a slide in a handful of key stocks on Wednesday to notch its third closing high in a row.  The Nasdaq Composite dropped 0.8%.  While the S&P pulled back from its previous closing high, the Dow marked its 24th of the year and third in as many days.
